channel.description: Latest articles from Estes Park Trail Gazette (eptrail.com)

item.title: Police video shows Vince McMahon’s 100 mph car crash in Connecticut
item.description: Police video shows him swerve, clip another car, hit a guardrail, and careen back.

item.title: FCC seeks public comment as live sports shift from broadcast TV to streaming
item.description: The comment period runs through March 27 and replies are due April 13.

item.title: Gov. Jared Polis moves to end his monthslong effort to comply with an ICE subpoena
item.description: Attorneys representing Gov. Jared Polis informed a Denver judge that the governor wanted a ruling that would indefinitely block him from ordering the release of information -- something he'd fought.

item.title: Justice Department says it’s reviewing whether any Epstein-related records were mistakenly withheld
item.description: Rep. Robert Garcia said in a statement that his panel would investigate the withheld records.

item.title: Bill would ban prop bets on sports apps in Colorado as lawmakers seek to curb gambling addictions
item.description: Colorado lawmakers who are concerned about rising gambling addiction and betting scandals in professional sports filed a bill Wednesday that would prohibit sports betting apps from offering proposition bets.

item.title: EVFPD weekly run report, week of Feb. 15
item.description: During the week of Feb. 15, 2026, the Estes Valley Fire Protection District (EVFPD) responded to 18 calls for service. This included: emergency medical (assist EPH): 7; alarm activation: 4; MVA (Motor Vehicle Accident): 3; gas leak: 2; elevator rescue: 1; illegal burn: 1.

item.title: Bird flu outbreak in California elephant seals prompts officials to cancel popular tours
item.description: They call it the first detected outbreak in marine mammals in California.

item.title: Maduro’s lawyer says US is blocking Venezuela government from paying deposed leader’s drug defense
item.description: The dispute over Maduro’s legal fees is intimately linked to U.S. foreign policy.

item.title: New York sues Counter-Strike game developer saying ‘loot boxes’ promote gambling
item.description: One item, an AK-47 Counter-Strike skin, recently sold for more than $1 million.

item.title: No-parking zone in Nancy Guthrie’s neighborhood widened amid complaints about journalists, streamers
item.description: The new restrictions take effect Thursday.
